cards.front: Recall a key point about Translation and Speaking Skills
cards.back: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for translation and speaking skills. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse spanish exam tips?
cards.back: For translation: identify key structures, check verb tenses, ensure agreement. For speaking: use a range of tenses, include opinions, ask questions. For role-play: be spontaneous, use appropriate register. For photocard: describe, give opinions, answer follow-up questions with detail.

cards.front: What does el falso amigo mean?
cards.back: the false friend (e.g. 'Embarazada' es un falso amigo)

cards.front: What does la expresión idiomática mean?
cards.back: the idiom (e.g. 'Llover a cántaros' es una expresión idiomática)

cards.front: What does la traducción literal mean?
cards.back: the literal translation (e.g. La traducción literal suele ser incorrecta)
the filler word (e.g. 'Pues' y 'bueno' son muletillas)
the self-correction (e.g. Los examinadores valoran la autocorrección)
to paraphrase (e.g. Si no sabes la palabra, parafrasea)
the context (e.g. El contexto ayuda a deducir el significado)

cards.front: What does la expresión coloquial mean?
cards.back: the colloquial expression (e.g. '¡Qué guay!' es una expresión coloquial)

cards.front: What does la gestión del tiempo mean?
cards.back: the time management (e.g. La gestión del tiempo es importante en el examen)
the revision/review (e.g. Dedica tiempo al repaso antes del examen)

cards.front: What does la comprensión cultural mean?
cards.back: the cultural understanding (e.g. La comprensión cultural demuestra un nivel superior)

cards.front: What does la referencia cultural mean?
cards.back: the cultural reference (e.g. Incluye referencias culturales en tus respuestas)
Writing task: Write about translation into english, translation into spanish, speaking strategies, role-play, photocard description.
